common: Create ONE standalone production catalog illustration for a polished casual fantasy mobile puzzle game. Match the corresponding preview category in the reference UI mockup, not its labels or UI frame. Large clear silhouette, attractive controlled color, soft dimensional material and clean highlights, immediately readable at 40 pixels. True transparent background, square composition, subject fills central 84 percent with balanced alpha margins. No surrounding tile, no background scene, no watermark, no label or UI text. Do not create a sheet or multiple unrelated icons. Only game letters or digits explicitly requested in the subject may be visible. Specific subject:

families.path: A luminous connecting route between matching cards, restrained glow, a few clear round endpoints. No thick gold border, jewelry or beads; retain the real effect color and topology while making a beautiful illustrative icon.
families.exit: A cream playing card with a fine warm-gold rim and a small clean blue geometric diamond (drawn shape, not a font glyph), with the removal effect visibly changing the card. Card is the dominant big object, slightly tilted at most, pieces large and clear rather than microscopic. Same card design throughout this family.
families.flip: A blue-backed cream playing card with thin gold rim and small simple geometric center diamond, and a clear gold or teal motion cue for the flip/reveal effect. Big simple forms, no labels, no letter on the card. Same card throughout this family.
families.theme: A friendly high-quality illustrated representative object or character for this card theme, like the reference's deer, noodle bowl, fruit and planet icons. Warm dimensional casual game illustration, bright clear color, simple strong silhouette; not a contact sheet of cards and not a screenshot.
families.back: One large beautiful collectible playing-card back, very slight tilt, softly dimensional rounded edges with a fine gold presentation rim. Faithfully show the existing back color/pattern specified, do not invent a different ornate motif or a new gameplay card design.
